item.title: mistralai/mistral-medium-3-5: deprecated
item.description: 2026-10-31: Official model card marks this model deprecated and recommends Large 4 for new integrations. Its current direct pricing row was removed; the previous official quote is historical. This does not establish an API shutdown or withdrawal of independently hosted weights/routes.
